limitations: evaluated on a generated fixture corpus; this says nothing about quality on real documents
the dense model encodes the whole corpus in memory and scores by dense matrix product, so its latency is not comparable to a production ANN index
no comparison against Mistral, Qwen, Llama, Gemma or DeepSeek was possible: none can be installed on this host, so no superiority claim over them is made or implied

under a held-out-TOPIC split (unseen vocabulary, not the deployment condition) the dense model scores MRR 0.012346 against BM25 0.382011 — it does not generalise to entirely unseen topic vocabularies at this data volume
